# Subathon timer triggers

## Time added

Runs every time time is added to (or taken from) a subathon timer: by a sub, bits, a tip, a follow, a raid, a reward or by hand. Good for a "+5:00" alert or a thank you.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Timer** | Only for this timer. Leave it empty for every timer. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%timer%` | The timer's name |
| `%seconds%` | Seconds added (negative when time was taken away), after the multiplier |
| `%formattedSeconds%` | The same as text, like +0:05:00 |
| `%user%` | Who added it (empty when it was added by hand) |
| `%platform%` | Their platform |
| `%reason%` | What added it, like Subscription, Cheer, Follow, the reward's name or Manual |
| `%remaining%` | Seconds left now |
| `%formattedRemaining%` | Time left now, like 4:05:00 |
| `%multiplier%` | The multiplier that was used |

<small>Type id: `subathon.timeAdded`</small>

## Timer ended

Runs when a subathon timer reaches 0:00:00. Good for ending the stream (an OBS sub-action), a raid or a big thank you.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Timer** | Only for this timer. Leave it empty for every timer. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%timer%` | The timer's name |
| `%elapsed%` | Seconds the subathon ran in all |
| `%formattedElapsed%` | How long it ran, like 26:03:10 |

<small>Type id: `subathon.ended`</small>

## Timer paused

Runs when a subathon timer is paused, by hand, by a sub-action or because your stream ended.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Timer** | Only for this timer. Leave it empty for every timer. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%timer%` | The timer's name |
| `%remaining%` | Seconds left |
| `%formattedRemaining%` | Time left, like 2:15:30 |
| `%elapsed%` | Seconds it has run so far |

<small>Type id: `subathon.paused`</small>

## Timer resumed

Runs when a paused subathon timer carries on.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Timer** | Only for this timer. Leave it empty for every timer. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%timer%` | The timer's name |
| `%remaining%` | Seconds left |
| `%formattedRemaining%` | Time left, like 2:15:30 |

<small>Type id: `subathon.resumed`</small>

## Timer started

Runs when a subathon timer starts (from its starting length). Good for announcing the subathon in chat.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Timer** | Only for this timer. Leave it empty for every timer. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%timer%` | The timer's name |
| `%timerId%` | The timer's internal id |
| `%state%` | Running |
| `%remaining%` | Seconds left |
| `%formattedRemaining%` | Time left, like 4:00:00 |
| `%elapsed%` | Seconds it has run so far |
| `%formattedElapsed%` | Time it has run so far, like 1:30:00 |
| `%multiplier%` | The multiplier for event time (1 = normal) |

<small>Type id: `subathon.started`</small>
